Job Description:

  • Keying all accounting and financial transactions into the company's accounting system accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Performing bookkeeping tasks, including but not limited to recording sales, purchases, receipts, and payments.
  • Reconciling bank statements and other financial records to ensure accuracy.
  • Verifying the accuracy of invoices, bills, receipts, and other financial documents.
  • Maintaining organized and up-to-date records of all financial transactions and documents.
  • Collaborating with other departments to gather necessary financial information and documentation.
  • Ensuring compliance with company policies and accounting standards.


﻿Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • 2 years of experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or a related field
  • Proficiency in using accounting software
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively to meet deadlines

Responsibilities

- Manage real time bidding campaigns on multiple platforms for clients (including but not limited to: Google Ads, Facebook ads, Line ads, Tiktok ads, etc.)

- Setup, monitor, report and analyze campaign results to meet the client's objectives

- To carry out regular optimization for a number of assigned ongoing accounts, ensuring the efficient day-to-day management of the campaigns

- Generate audience and tracking pixels for campaigns.

- Check marketing pixels is correctly implemented.

- Setup & maintain regular campaign reports with recommendation

- Guide the assigned specialist

Qualifications and Experience:

- At least 2-4 years biddable specialist experience (Focusing on these platforms: Facebook/Google Ads/TikTok/LINE Lap/X)

- Experience in various client industries, campaign types, specialize in 4+ platforms

- Understanding the relevant metrics & platform logic

- Able to find information, keep trend updates, and solve the problem

- Able to analyze metric data and convey recommendations appropriately to media planner.

- Ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment.

- Able to explain complicated subject to team member to understand

- Self-motivated, result-driven, fast-paced and be able to prioritize daily work efficiently.

- Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Works effectively in a fast-paced, energetic team environment.

- Open-minded, have passion to learn

Client Information:
Our client is a really small-size oil production company which has been operated in Thailand for almost 10 years. They are looking for Accounting & Admin Manager who's confident in working independently for the following job scopes.﻿﻿


Key Responsibilities:

  • To make sure that companys financial statements for the past 10 years are correct and in compliance with accounting principles
  • Handle any accounting transactions (not over 10 transactions/ month) as well as preparing document for account closing and sending to Accounting Firm
  • Support BOI documents as requested
  • Provide accounting report to Director as requested
  • Assist in any administrative tasks within the company
  • System: ERP
    ﻿

Requirements:

  • Thai native speaker
  • Bachelors degree in accounting field
  • 3-5 years of experience in overall accounting including preparing accounting documents for accounting firm
  • Experience in audit firm is highly preferable
  • Willing to work independently in a very small-size company
  • Proficiency in using accounting software
  • Fair command in English
